oneLine: The first requests after a deploy are slow because the model is still loading.
summary: Send a few throwaway requests before real traffic arrives (see 9.2).

mechanism.title: Deploy
mechanism.body: A new replica starts without the weights in memory.

mechanism.title: Load
mechanism.body: The first request triggers the slow load.

mechanism.title: Warm
mechanism.body: Later requests run at normal speed.

keyCards.label: Cause
keyCards.title: Cold weights
keyCards.body: Nothing is in memory on a fresh replica.

keyCards.label: Fix
keyCards.title: Warm it
keyCards.body: Load before traffic, not during it.

checkQuestion.explanation: The shared read is the expensive part, so sharing it is what helps.
checkQuestion.sourceQuote: The first request after a deploy pays for loading weights into memory.
